D1.evidence: Rule lines applied (prereg): LBA-P1 '`tau_b(F1[refs1_randk](DETAILED), F1[complete](DETAILED))` tau_lt (tau0 0.9; with 8 models: at least 2 discordant pairs of 28 (no ties))'; tau_lt: 'PASS if ci95_hi < tau0; FAIL if point >= tau0; else INCONCLUSIVE'; tau0 = 0.9. The verdict function is built by parsing these rule strings, not typed. cv295: tau_b point -0.286, 95% CI [-0.571, 0.000], 8 models; ci95_hi 0.000 < tau0 -> PASS (output: PASS). uv231en: tau_b point -0.857, 95% CI [-0.929, -0.500]; ci95_hi -0.500 < tau0 -> PASS (output: PASS). KM does not bite (kept models: 8 of 8 on both sets; LBA-P1 is NOT_EVALUABLE only below 6). Mismatches with the output: [].

D2.evidence: Rule lines applied: LBA-P2 'per model m, compound of `slope[refs_all](PAIR_m) - slope[refs1_randk](PAIR_m)` sign_gt_0, `slope[complete](PAIR_m) - slope[refs_all](PAIR_m)` sign_gt_0 and `slope[complete](PAIR_m)` sign_gt_0; per set models_compound'; sign_gt_0: 'PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE'; compound: 'FAIL if any part is FAIL; else NOT_EVALUABLE if any part is NOT_EVALUABLE; else PASS if every part is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE'; models_compound: 'over the models evaluable on the set: FAIL if any model is FAIL; PASS if every model is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE; NOT_EVALUABLE if fewer than half of the registered models are evaluable'. All 48 part verdicts (models x 3 parts x 2 sets), the 16 per-model compounds and the 2 set verdicts were recomputed from the stored point and CI: mismatches with the output = 0. cv295 per-model compounds: llava15_7b PASS, llava_ov_7b INCONCLUSIVE, qwen25vl_3b PASS, qwen25vl_7b PASS, qwen3vl_8b FAIL, internvl3_8b PASS, idefics3_8b INCONCLUSIVE, smolvlm2_2b PASS -> models_compound FAIL (8 of 8 evaluable; both readings of the NOT_EVALUABLE clause agree: True). llava_ov_7b is INCONCLUSIVE because slope[complete](PAIR_m) = 2.724 [-3.710, 8.085] has ci95_lo <= 0 and point > 0; idefics3_8b is INCONCLUSIVE because slope[complete] - slope[refs_all] = 4.977 [-2.750, 12.690] has ci95_lo <= 0 and point > 0; the other 5 models PASS on all three parts. uv231en: all 8 models PASS -> models_compound PASS (output: PASS); cv295 set verdict FAIL (output: FAIL). Points re-derived from the output's own per-run score table (two-point slopes, scipy kendalltau-b): max |diff| over 48 part points 7.1e-15, over the 2 LBA-P1 taus 0.0e+00; every pair's M differ (min |ln M ratio| 0.328), so no slope is undefined.

D3.evidence: Kill rules applied: KA1 'fires when LBA-P1 is FAIL on cv295'; KA2 'fires when LBA-P2 is FAIL on cv295 or uv231en'; KM 'a model has a run missing or excluded by KD on a set -> the model leaves every analysis of that set; LBA-P1 is NOT_EVALUABLE there if fewer than 6 of the 8 models remain (fewer than 15 pairs)'; KL 'verdicts use the clean analysis set only; its size is reported'; KD 'a run whose provenance shows a model file, prompt, decoding setting, batch size or package version other than registered'; counting: 'Kill rules count FAIL only. INCONCLUSIVE is reported as inconclusive and never as support.'. KA1: LBA-P1 on cv295 is PASS -> does not fire (output False). KA2: LBA-P2 on cv295 is FAIL -> fires; failing models {'cv295': ['qwen3vl_8b'], 'uv231en': []} (output True, {'cv295': ['qwen3vl_8b'], 'uv231en': []}). KM: no model leaves either set. KL: analysis sets {'cv295': 291, 'uv231en': 231} (cv295 291 of 295; uv231en 231 of 231). KD: no exclusions. Main's reading is confirmed.

D4.evidence: qwen3vl_8b on cv295 fails on part 3, slope[complete](PAIR_m): point -1.124, 95% CI [-11.522, 6.618]. The rule is sign_gt_0 = 'PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE': ci95_lo is not > 0 and the point is <= 0, so the part is FAIL through the 'point <= 0' clause. The CI contains 0 (ci95_hi = 6.618 > 0), so this is NOT a significant negative slope: the interval also contains positive slopes (up to 6.618). 'compound' ('FAIL if any part is FAIL') makes the model FAIL, 'models_compound' ('FAIL if any model is FAIL') makes cv295 FAIL and KA2 fires; per the prereg's 'counting' rule kill rules count FAIL only, so the firing is mechanical. Its other parts: slope[refs_all] - slope[refs1_randk] = 21.157 [15.330, 26.848] PASS; slope[complete] - slope[refs_all] = 5.355 [-2.588, 13.321] INCONCLUSIVE. Sensitivity on all 295 images (registered without verdicts): slope[complete] -1.962 [-12.967, 6.499], the same sign, so the point-estimate FAIL does not come from the 4-image KL restriction. Wording for the paper: 'the point estimate is <= 0 (CI includes 0)', never 'significantly negative'.

notes_for_writer: Reporting constraint (prereg section 9): A-N2 verdicts are registered SECONDARY, body only (never abstract or conclusions); every cv295 verdict must say that CV295 lies inside COCO-2500 (replication with new models on discovery images, not an image-out-of-sample test); uv231en results carry the exposure label 'COCO train2014 images; exposure during pre-training possible'. KA2 consequence: Paper A reports C2 as not holding for every public LVLM, names qwen3vl_8b, and does not write 'replicates across models'.

Disclose in the body (registered descriptive item): hit_max share is 1.0 (every detailed_en caption ran to the 160-token limit) for ['idefics3_8b', 'qwen3vl_8b'] on both sets. No effect on any verdict is inferred here: the share is the same for qwen3vl_8b on uv231en, where its slope[complete] verdict is PASS, and for idefics3_8b on both sets, where its slope[complete] verdicts are PASS (cv295) and PASS (uv231en).

parity_slice0 (slice 0 decoded at the registered batch size and at batch size 1) is not all-identical in 23 of 32 runs; the prereg records it with no gate, so it is not a KD condition, but it shows batch-size sensitivity of greedy bf16/fp16 decodes.

This record does not re-verify the scorer's design choices already ruled in CC-039 (R1-R7); it checks that the scorer as committed ran on the registered inputs and that its numbers and verdicts reproduce, also from an independent implementation.
